# MediKart

MediKart is an online health and wellness storefront offering medicines, wellness essentials, personal care, secure checkout, and customer support.

- [Home](https://medikartwebsite.vercel.app/)
- [All products](https://medikartwebsite.vercel.app/products)
- [Medicines](https://medikartwebsite.vercel.app/category/medicine)
- [Wellness](https://medikartwebsite.vercel.app/category/wellness)
- [Care support](https://medikartwebsite.vercel.app/support)
